audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill while every whys[] line on the page says the stage is yours.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Tryndamere all seven rows at a 54.38% win rate over 1039 games, and the mirror audit states Tryndamere is favoured at every stage.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 set to Tryndamere in both layers, giving a chart that agrees with its own text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns given, and the page treats 'when Heart Zapper is down' as the trading window without saying how long that is.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s, Infected Bonesaw is 4s and free, Blunt Force Trauma 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s, and Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s at every rank — the same as your Undying Rage at rank 1 but never shortening.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text and spikes[1].text now carry the 17s, 4s and 120s figures.

audit.whatIsWrong: Goes Where He Pleases was never mentioned: it resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him and drops a chemical canister he can walk over to heal and shorten its cooldown.
audit.why: It is the reason a jungle gank or a Stridebreaker slow often does nothing the first time, and the canister is a denyable resource — walking him off it is real counterplay the page did not contain.
audit.corrected: mid now states the immobilise resist and the canister denial.
sources: enemyKit P text and hardCC flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The two heals were never attributed. Heart Zapper stores a portion of the damage he takes and heals him when its burst hits; Maximum Dosage heals a percent of MISSING health.
audit.why: Both change how you fight him. Damage you pour into Heart Zapper is partly banked as his heal, and bursting him low is exactly what makes his ultimate heal for the most — so Grievous Wounds has to land before the burst, not after.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and wants.foe[2] state the storage, the missing-health scaling and the anti-heal timing.
sources: enemyKit W text and heal flag

edits.before: Mundo's only early threat is Infected Bonesaw (Q) poke, but with Fury built you Bloodlust-heal it back instantly. He can't punish you at all: E in, Q crit, W to slow his low-mobility escape, and walk out. Deny his cleaver by juking behind minions and you control every trade.
edits.after: Mundo's only early threat is Infected Bonesaw — free, up every 4s, and scaled off your CURRENT health, so it chips you but never finishes you. With Fury built you Bloodlust it straight back: E in, Q crit, W to slow his escape, walk out. Juke the cleaver behind minions.

edits.before: Mundo's Maximum Dosage (R) gives huge sustain and move speed, but it doesn't save him from a committed Tryndamere all-in. With full Fury and Undying Rage you out-heal his regen and crit through his tankiness. Force fights while his R is down and punish his weak wave clear.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage heals a percent of his MISSING health, so it pays him most when he is nearly dead — chunking him and backing off is what feeds it. It is a flat 120s at every rank: land Grievous Wounds first, force the fight while it is down, and crit through the regen on full Fury.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you dominate. His low mobility means your W slow and E gap-close lock him down, and Bloodlust out-sustains his passive regen. His level-6 R gives sustain but no kill threat, so keep forcing trades and shoving him under tower.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you dominate. His low mobility means your W slow and E gap-close pin him, and Bloodlust out-sustains his regen. His passive eats the first immobilise and drops a canister that heals him — deny the pickup; his R gives sustain, not kills.

edits.before: His sustain spike + reset. Crit when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heart Zapper is 17s and banks the damage you pour in as his heal — crit after it bursts.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage both heal — Executioner's first.

edits.before: Pop R sustain to survive a trade
edits.after: Pop R: it heals his missing health
